description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans serialization framework, focusing on external JSON serializers such as Newtonsoft.Json and System.Text.Json. It tests serialization round-trips, serializer configuration modifications, and framework type handling within the Orleans project.

classes.name: ExternalCodecTests
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests to verify the behavior of external serializations in Orleans.

classes.name: JsonTypeAttribute
classes.description: A custom attribute used to mark types intended to be serialized with JSON serializers.

classes.name: JsonPoco
classes.description: A sample data class used for testing JSON serialization, with custom property names.

methods.name: ExternalCodecTests
methods.description: Constructor initializing the test environment with default serializers.

methods.name: NewtonsoftJsonCodec_ExternalSerializer_Client
methods.description: Tests serialization round-trip using Newtonsoft JSON serializer in client context.

methods.name: NewtonsoftJsonCodec_ExternalSerializer_Silo
methods.description: Tests serialization round-trip in a silo (server) context.

methods.name: NewtonsoftJsonCodec_CanModifySerializerSettings
methods.description: Verifies that Orleans JSON serializer settings can be modified and correctly affect serialization.

methods.name: NewtonsoftJsonCodec_DoesNotSerializeFrameworkTypes
methods.description: Ensures that framework types (like SiloAddress, GrainReference) are not serialized using Newtonsoft.Json codecs.

methods.name: SystemTextJsonCodec_DoesNotSerializeFrameworkTypes
methods.description: Ensures that framework types are not serialized using System.Text.Json codecs.

methods.name: ProtocolBuffersCodec_DoesNotSerializeFrameworkTypes
methods.description: Ensures that framework types are not serialized using Protocol Buffers codecs.

methods.name: TestSerializationRoundTrip
methods.description: Helper method to test serialization and deserialization consistency.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts byte array to a hexadecimal string for easier inspection.
